# 2026-09-17

Ten years. Gave Priya the necklace from the room safe at breakfast in 914
(sapphire pendant, $1,840 from Cicely Jewelers, she has no idea what it cost).
Windmills at Zaanse Schans, poffertjes, then Lindengracht 41: the best dinner
we've had. We talked about a second kid again. Priya wants to decide by spring;
I'm not sure, given the business. Didn't fight about it, which is progress.
